title: Dependencies
intro: Every dependency of the plan: the successor waits for the predecessor. The ones that do not hold are listed first and only warn; nothing moves. The owners of the successor's project, or an administrator, can change a dependency's type and lag or delete it in its row; a new one is added on the page of its successor's project.
empty: The plan has no dependencies yet
noMatchShown: None of the first {{count}} dependencies matches the filters
truncated: The list shows its first {{count}} dependencies.
